assertions.assertion: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of palpitations and lightheadedness consistent with supraventricular tachycardia
The patient has a background of known atherosclerotic heart disease of the native coronary artery
Mobile cardiac telemetry (CPT 93229) is ordered to capture intermittent arrhythmic events and correlate symptoms with rhythm disturbances over an extended monitoring period
The symptomatic supraventricular tachycardia is supported by diagnosis I47.1
The patient has a diagnosis of atherosclerotic heart disease of the native coronary artery (I25.10)
SilverBridge Advantage issued denial CO-197 citing missing prior approval for this diagnostic procedure
The payer requires authorization to reflect medical necessity
